title: Spaghetti Carbonara
summary: A classic Italian pasta dish with eggs, cheese, bacon, and black pepper.
instructions: Marinate chicken with yorgut and spices for 1 hour
Grill or sear chicken until cooked through
Prepare sauce with tomato puree and cream
Add grilled chicken to sauce and simmer 10 minutes

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
summary: Chunks of grilled chicken (tikka) cooked in a smooth buttery & creamy tomato based gravy.
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package instrucions
Whisk eggs and cheese in a bowl
Combine drained spaghetti with pancetta and egg mixture
Season with black pepper and serve immediately

title: Ugali
summary: A basic African dish cooked with water and maize flour.
instructions: Heat the water until it boils
Add the flour bits by bits while stirring
Cook until it is not sticky
